notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
description:
Activate Whisperer of the Wilds by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Whisperer of the Wilds.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Whisperer of the Wilds.
Repeat.
